annotations.title: Check a proposed labor rate against GSA awarded rates

description:
Screens a proposed hourly labor rate against the GSA CALC+ ceiling rates awarded for the same labor category, e.g. keyword 'systems engineer' with proposed_rate 145. Returns where the rate falls (percentile), a verdict (within the interquartile range, above the 75th percentile, above every awarded rate, below the 25th percentile, or too few comparables), the price summary (min, p25, median, p75, max) and the 5 lowest comparable rates. Optional filters: sin, education, min_years_experience. Use it for price-reasonableness and price-realism checks on proposals and independent government cost estimates.
FREE tier: shares the 20 calls per visitor per 24h of search_labor_rates. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

min_years_experience.description: Only rates requiring at least this many years.

sin.description: GSA Special Item Number filter, e.g. 54151S.
